agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 18, 2021 -
06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Sanderson
Approve the Warrants.
2021-08-18 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Update California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services Designation of Applicant’s Agent Resolution (form Cal OES 130). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Jimenez
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-84 authorizing the City Manager, Finance Director, or the Fire Chief to execute applications to the California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services for obtaining certain federal financial assistance and/or state financial assistance in the event of a declared disaster (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Authorize staff to complete an updated resolution form (Cal OES 130) required by California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services to be executed by the governing body of the jurisdiction requesting reimbursement (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-08-18 Item 08B CALOES 130 resolution
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Public Hearing and introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2021-13 which proposes Municipal Code amendments to implement the measures in the City’s Climate Action Plan related to commercial building energy efficiency, renewable energy, and building decarbonization. Contact Person: Sustainability Manager Najera
CASE NOS: PLCY-004592-2021; LOCATION: Citywide.
1) Open the public hearing; and 2) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2021-13, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of Encinitas, Adopting Amendments to Chapter 23.12 (Uniform Codes for Construction) of Title 23 (Building and Construction) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Adopt the 2019 California Building Code and California Green Building Code with Certain Amendments, Additions, and Deletions related to Energy Efficiency, Solar Energy and Building Decarbonization” (Attachments 1 and 2 of the agenda report).
2021-08-18 Item 10A CAP Building Code Requirements Intro Ordinance
2021-08-18 Item 10A CAP Building Code Requirements Intro Ordinance - Staff Presentation
10B.
Public Hearing and Introduction of City Council Ordinances No. 2021-10, No. 2021-11, and No. 2021-12, which proposes amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan to implement Program 3A of the 5th Cycle Housing Element 2013-2021. The proposed amendments are to establish parking standards appropriate for different kinds of housing related development including transit-oriented and inclusionary affordable units, and tandem parking. Contact Person: Planning Manager Gates
1) Introduce Ordinance No. 2021-10 titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and Local Coastal Plan to modify existing parking requirements to allow tandem parking in a multi-family housing development" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); 2) Introduce Ordinance No. 2021-11 titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and Local Coastal Plan to establish parking requirements for transit-oriented housing development" (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); and 3) Introduce Ordinance No. 2021-12 titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting amendment to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and Local Coastal Plan to establish parking requirements for inclusionary housing units" (Attachment 3 of the agenda report).
2021-08-18 Item 10B Parking Amendments Intro Ordinance
10C.
Project scope refinement for design and construction of the Santa Fe Drive Corridor Bike and Pedestrian Improvements Projects (CS19E). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize City Staff to modify the project scope for the design and construction of the Santa Fe Drive Bike and Pedestrian Improvements Project.
2021-08-18 Item 10C Santa Fe Drive Scope Change
2021-08-18 Item 10C Santa Fe Drive Scope Change - Staff Presentation

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON AUGUST 25, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
